Accounting, tax and billing · Start · Tested
In 1 minute

Manual journal entry review

Gabriel · General Ledger Accountant

A retail chain with 60 stores processes 38 thousand journal entries a month, of which 2,100 are manual: adjustments, reclassifications, provisions and write-offs.

When it runs
On D+3 of each close, when the accountant exports the month's manual entry ledger from the ERP in CSV, before closing the accounting period
What it delivers in production
On D+3 the accountant receives the manual entries sorted by risk signal, with the reason for each flag and the suggested correction, and corrects them before closing the period instead of explaining them to the auditor.
Who decides
Lists and suggests; the accountant decides
Effort
Calibrate on three months; two reviewed closes
Set up5 steps · 6 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# Manual journal entry policy

It applies to every manual entry in the ledger, in any account and cost center.

## Requirements
- Supporting document mandatory above R$ 5,000.00 (invoice, contract, calculation memo).
- Approver different from the one who posts. Posted and approved by the same code is a control failure, never an accusation.
- Authorized recurring entries are in recurring.xlsx, with the expected amount. Tolerance: 5%.

## Reading the signals
- Round amount: exact multiple of R$ 1,000.00.
- Generic description: only words like adjustment, settlement, sundry, entry, as per, regularization.
- Income statement account: nature "income_statement" in chart_of_accounts.csv, on the debit or the credit side.
- An entry belongs to a recurring item when the debit account is the recurring item's account and the description contains its description.
- Reversal: description "Reversal of entry N". It has a pair when entry N is in manual_entries.csv.

## Audit findings (2024 and 2025)
| Year | Finding | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 | Adjustment in general expenses with debit and credit in the same account | 1-word description, no document |
| 2024 | Supplier payment posted and approved by the same person | round amount, end of month |
| 2025 | Inventory receipt without an invoice, regularized the following month | high amount, no document |
| 2025 | Rent recurring entry above the contract due to an unapproved increase | difference above 5% |

## Rules with no leeway
- Signals counted one by one. E.g.: 880103 has 3 (same account 4.1.3.02, description "adjustment", R$ 18,000.00 with no document): high, the accountant decides.
- High also with 1 signal or more above R$ 100,000.00. E.g.: 880107, R$ 650,000.00 with 1 signal: high and internal audit informed. 880105 (R$ 132,400.00, energy provision +1.85%, day 29) has 0 signals: low.
- A recurring entry within 5% is not a round amount, even with no document. E.g.: 880101, store 22 rent, R$ 48,000.00 equal to the expected: 0 signals. 880102, store 35, R$ 33,600.00 against R$ 30,000.00 (+12%), plus Oct 30 in an income statement account: 2 signals, medium.
- Last 2 calendar days of October: Oct 30 and 31, even on a Saturday. E.g.: 880106 on Oct 31 with R$ 7,000.00 and no document: medium.
- An empty approver only applies to that row: SEGREGATION NOT VERIFIABLE, no signal. E.g.: 880111. Same user: only 880104 (U0141), which goes to the accountant and the accounting coordinator.
- A person's name in the description does not appear anywhere in the output. E.g.: in 880104 write "Supplier payment at the request of [name omitted]". Users only by code.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent does not reverse, correct or approve entries: it lists and suggests, and the accountant decides before the close, because an automatic reversal of a legitimate provision distorts the month's result. A segregation of duties item (the same person posts and approves) is a control failure, never an accusation against a user, and the output identifies who posted by code. A round amount is only a signal when it is outside the list of authorized recurring entries. The full list is restricted to the accountant and internal audit.

Common mistakes

  • Treating every round amount as suspicious and burying the accountant in legitimate fixed contracts.
  • Flagging a reversal without checking for its pair in the same or the previous month; a legitimate provision reversal looks like an entry with no offset.
  • Looking only at the entry's content and ignoring who posts and who approves.
  • Reviewing only entries above a high amount, missing the pattern of many small adjustments.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
External audit findings on manual entriesfrom 17 in the previous fiscal year to fewer than 5, with correction before the closeestimate based on the described routine
Manual entries reviewed before the closefrom the auditor's sample to all manual entries classified, with high-priority ones decided on D+3process target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
Historical findings recovered in calibration17 out of 17 at high priority with a list of up to 60 items a month, measured in calibrationestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. August 2026 manual entries: 2,084 entries, R$ 41.2 million in activity.
HIGH | Entry 880412 | 2026-08-29 | Dr 4.1.3.02 / Cr 4.1.3.02 General expenses | R$ 18,000.00 | description: adjustment | signals: same account, round amount, 1-word description, no document | suggestion: identify the offset or reverse
HIGH | Entry 880377 | 2026-08-28 | Dr 2.1.1.04 Suppliers / Cr 1.1.1.02 Bank | R$ 250,000.00 | signals: round amount, posted and approved by user 0141, no document | suggestion: attach proof and approval from another user
HIGH | Entry 880201 | 2026-08-14 | Dr 4.2.1.01 Rent store 22 / Cr 2.1.4.01 Rent payable | R$ 61,500.00 | authorized recurring entry expected R$ 48,000.00, +28% | suggestion: check for adjustment or duplicate
(+35 similar at high priority)
MEDIUM | Entry 880090 | electricity provision R$ 132,400.00 | no reversal of the July provision (R$ 128,900.00) | suggestion: confirm reversal | (+116 similar)
RECURRING ENTRIES NOT FOUND: depreciation for store 41, expected R$ 9,300.00.
SUMMARY: 38 high-priority items, 117 medium, 1,929 low; 9 posted and approved by the same person; 3 reversals without a pair.
